_comment: Issue #24 review wave (M1, controller ruling): rock_crab_nest's confirm conversation -- the awakened_boss/relc_descent confirm-shape applied to a T1 cull target, so a fresh classless player gets INFORMED CONSENT before an armored fight (the node text IS the armor telegraph; copy is controller-BINDING, verbatim). Run by the floodplains `rock_crab_nest` encounter's `conversation` field (interact.encounter branch fires dialogue BEFORE combat). [Strike first.] ends the conversation and fires `start_combat: rock_crab_nest` (self-reference; legal ONLY on an ending option -- start_combat refuses while dialogue is non-null, see relc_descent's own precedent comment). [Back away.] plainly ends -- no combat, the encounter stays live and re-interactable. TRAP (dormant re-interact): rock_crab_nest is respawns:true; interact() dispatches to dialogue WITHOUT a dormancy check, so a player who re-interacts the same waking after a victory re-opens this conversation and [Strike first.] falls to start_combat's dormant refusal -- DIALOGUE_EFFECT_FAILED fires, no combat, no crash (the sanctioned failure path; the next sleep re-arms the fight for real). No requires/hide_when on any option (no progress leak), so the softlock guard is trivially satisfied.

confront.speaker: Boulder Shapes
confront.text: One of the boulder shapes grinds upright — plates of grey stone sliding over something alive underneath. It does not hurry. Things armored like that rarely need to.
